commits_data.message:
candump: Replace Flex/Lemon logic with just "straight C"

There are several wiretaps supporting text-based files for CAN networks (that read into SocketCAN encapsulation type).  Working towards finding more commonality between all of them and "straight C" is easier to refactor when commonality is found because the parsing logic isn't that complicated.
